buildRequirements: Use fresh owned factory copies, never original runtime/test roots or original cached binary directories.
Retain exact parent Package.swift and every Sources/SwiftRightRuntime file.
Only source delta is TaskIDTests.swift assertion message. Pin original and diagnostic complete source manifests.
Build release with same Swift toolchain, XCTest/Testing runtime loader and framework pins; archive diagnostics as distinct binaries with their own executable and DLL hashes.
Do not run full suite to seek passing results. No changed waits, graph uses, task code, assertions or thresholds.

eventInterpretation.cancelled a then commit=false a: Existing task cancellation and rejected guarded commit observed; trace alone does not identify cancellation source.
eventInterpretation.commit=false a without cancelled a: Guarded commit rejected. Existing KeyedWork false result can be nil TaskOwner.current or isLive false; trace does not distinguish missing task-local token, deallocated node, dead node or generation mismatch.
eventInterpretation.commit=true a: Existing action accepted. If assertion still reports empty results, retain raw contradiction for separate investigation.
eventInterpretation.start a only: Task start was observed; no existing completion or cancellation event had been logged by assertion failure. Late completion is consistent but exact scheduler mechanism is not proved.

limits: Changing diagnostic message changes compiled test bytes; diagnostic outcomes cannot replace original same-binary results.
All passing diagnostics produce no failure-event trace and cannot establish a cause.
No fixes until a concrete mechanism is independently evidenced.

capture: Source, toolchain, loader, executable and DLL pins before and after runs
Selected test count, stdout, stderr, exit code, timeout, CPU load, owned process path/PID/start/end
Every pass and failure; preserve original full175, original10 and original8e47 five-run archives
